heroHeadline: Russian Strike Kills 4 at Pavlohrad Mall as Ukraine Hits Caspian Port and Saratov Refinery, Prosecutors Report POW Execution
heroSubtitle: A Russian drone-and-guided-bomb strike on a crowded shopping center in Pavlohrad killed 4 people and injured more than 60, including three teenage boys, on September 10 — Foreign Minister Sybiha called it an attempt to inflict maximum civilian casualties. Overnight the same day, Ukraine's General Staff confirmed strikes on Russia's Caspian port at Makhachkala, Dagestan, and on three Russian naval vessels near Novorossiysk; Ukrainian FP-1 drones then hit the Saratov oil refinery and an Ozon logistics warehouse on September 11, destroying an estimated 85,000 square meters of the depot. Separately, Donetsk Oblast prosecutors said Russian troops executed two captured Ukrainian National Guard soldiers near Dobropillia on September 2, opening a war-crimes investigation. Russian military losses reached ~1,503,880 since 2022 per the Ukrainian General Staff, an increase of ~1,490 in the latest 24 hours.
